name: Visible Ollama agent prepares an ORD-1001 refund proposal

messages.content: Use the WebMCP tools registered by this page to prepare a return for ORD-1001. Call exactly one tool per turn and use the real IDs returned by each preceding tool. Search for ORD-1001 with limit 5; the unique result should provide item IDs in selectedOrder.items. Select the first returnable item and read its locked return policy. Check eligibility with requested quantity 1, reason wrong_size, condition opened_unused, explicit customer consent to offer store credit, and idempotency key demo-eligibility-ord1001. Compare the customer_value resolutions, but choose refund. Draft an unsent customer message with a warm tone and en-US locale. Submit the exact draft subject and bodyText for human approval with idempotency key demo-proposal-ord1001. Stop when the proposal reaches pending. Never perform final approval.
